item.title: Sunday prep keeps failing by Wednesday
item.dc:creator: Jane Exampleton
item.content:encoded:
Every Sunday I cook five lunches and by Wednesday I am sick of the same rice and chicken.

Quoted reply from someone else that must not count as her words.

Jane Exampleton here again, does anyone rotate two recipes so the week feels less boring? Mail me at jane@example.org

item.title: Budget containers that survive the dishwasher
item.author: pat.k_99
item.description: I bought cheap containers twice and both sets cracked in the dishwasher within a month, so now I only buy glass even though it is heavy to carry to work every single day.
